import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        double a = sc.nextDouble();
        double b = sc.nextDouble();
        long limit = sc.nextLong();

        double minDifference = Double.MAX_VALUE;
        long numerator = 0;
        long denominator = 1;

        for (long i = 1; i <= limit; i++) {
            double val = (a * i) / b;
            long floorVal = (long) Math.floor(val);
            double diffFloor = Math.abs((a / b) - ((double) floorVal / i));
            if (diffFloor < minDifference) {
                minDifference = diffFloor;
                numerator = floorVal;
                denominator = i;
            }
            long ceilVal = (long) Math.ceil(val);
            double diffCeil = Math.abs((a / b) - ((double) ceilVal / i));
            if (diffCeil < minDifference) {
                minDifference = diffCeil;
                numerator = ceilVal;
                denominator = i;
            }
        }
        System.out.println(numerator + "/" + denominator);
        sc.close();
    }
}
